text.description_html:
Omnia 7500/65, 2-9/16 Inch Brushed Stainless Steel Round Sliding Door Pull

The Large Round Brushed Stainless Steel Flush Pull has a 2-9/16 inch outer diameter. Flush pulls are mortised into the face of the door and are for use on sliding doors, pocket doors, cabinet doors--any door where a flush pull is desired. A low profile design allows you to slide a pocket door in and out without the pull catching. The 2-9/16 Inch Round Brushed Stainless Steel Flush Pull features a lip for fingers to catch on to for easy use.

Also Available: matching 2 Inch Round Flush Pull and 1-3/8 Inch Round Flush Pull

Specifications for the Omnia 7500/65 Flush Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Overall Diameter: 2-9/16"
  • Inner Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Depth: 5/8"
  • Door Hole Cut Out: 2"
  • Packaged with installation screws.
  • Omnia 7500 Installation Template (PDF)

Sold Individually
